feed.title: SAFER Lab
feed.subtitle: SAFER Lab is the research arm of SR4A (Safety and Resilience for All) — evidence, tools and training for safer roads, climate-resilient transport, and smart cities that serve everyone.

entry.title: SAFER Lab launches as the research arm of SR4A

link.title: SAFER Lab launches as the research arm of SR4A

entry.content:
SAFER Lab (Safety Analytics for Equitable & Resilient mobility) is the new research home of SR4A, Safety and Resilience for All. The lab brings together our peer-reviewed work on weather-related crash risk, crash severity modeling and automated-vehicle readiness, and will grow with every conference season.

Our publications are listed on the research page and are pulled automatically from ORCID, and our research themes are laid out under Research Themes. If you would like to collaborate, get in touch.
